title: ImpliHateVid: A Benchmark Dataset and Two-stage Contrastive Learning Framework for Implicit Hate Speech Detection in Videos
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures implicit and explicit hate speech in videos, where hate speech is defined as content that promotes discrimination, disparages, or humiliates an individual or group based on characteristics including religion.
findings: The paper includes religion as a protected characteristic in its definition of hate speech for the dataset annotation. However, the results are not disaggregated by the target of hate, so there are no specific findings on the model's performance in detecting religious-based hate speech versus other types like racial or gender-based hate.
